decisionsTitle: A volunteer ticks every role they would do; the organizers give each one a role
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14 morning**, on the volunteers' public form (§754, §758, in production): «Când se înscrie un voluntar, poate bifa mai multe atribuțiuni din ce e dispus să facă (definite de noi), de exemplu: stă la masă, stă pe traseu, stă în punctele de alimentare etc.». The form took **one** role; a volunteer should tick every role of the event they are willing to do, and the organizers then give each volunteer the role they need them in. Amends §754 (the form, the card, the count, the emails, the CSV) and §758 (the role the agreement names).

**Decision — the data.** A table of its own, `event_volunteer_role_choices` (migration `0149`, expand only): the volunteer (`ON DELETE CASCADE`), a role of the event, the moment, the pair the primary key — the roles the person said they would do. `event_volunteers.role_id` stays and becomes the role **given** by the organizers; it accepts NULL for an offer nobody has placed yet (a relaxing change: dropping `NOT NULL` refuses nothing the code serving during the migration writes, so it is an expand). Every existing volunteer's role became both their one choice and the role given, in the same migration (`tests/integration/db/volunteer-role-choices-migration.test.ts` proves the backfill on PGlite, twice-safe). **The choice's reference to the role is `CASCADE`, not `RESTRICT`**: deleting an event cascades to its roles and to its volunteers, and a choice is reached only through the volunteers' second-level cascade — after the roles' own check — so a `RESTRICT` (or `NO ACTION`) there refused deleting every event with an offer (proven on PGlite before the change). The service still refuses deleting a role anybody was given **or ticked**, cancelled people included (`VOLUNTEER_ROLE_HAS_PEOPLE`: change their roles first), so nothing a person offered disappears under them.

**«N din M» counts the roles given, only.** An offer holds no place: the role's need is counted against the people the organizers gave it («Înscris» and «Confirmat», never «Anulat», as before), and the public form's «mai e nevoie de N» reads the same count. A role may be given to more people than it asked («3 din 2»), as a hand entry always could. §754's accepted residual — a new address on the form lowered the public count, a listed one did not — is gone with it: a sign-up no longer moves the count.

**The public form.** The role select becomes «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci» / “What you are willing to do”: a fieldset with a glyph, one native checkbox per role that still needs people (the house's `CheckboxField`, one name `roleIds` posted once per tick, a 44-pixel row), each with its name and, under it, its description and how many it still needs. At least one is the service's rule, said in plain words in the refusal's summary and at the group («Bifează cel puțin un rol la „Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci”»); the ticks come back after a refusal through the sealed draft (one string of ids), never in the address. Works with scripts off. The consent, the agreement's and the age's ticks, the honeypot, the timing check, Turnstile and both throttles are unchanged. **A role that filled while the form was open:** the post locks the ticked roles (in the order of their ids — the order a role change locks them, so two posts ticking the same roles in opposite orders never deadlock; the two-connection suite holds it) and keeps those that still need people; the others ticked are kept; only when none is left is the offer refused politely («Rolurile bifate tocmai s-au umplut»), the roles still open listed under it — and, as before, that «full» is answered before the repeat is looked for, so it tells a listed address from a stranger by nothing. A repeat changes nothing, the choices included.

**The card «Voluntari».** A group **«De repartizat»** above the roles holds the offers with no role given, with how many wait («K de repartizat», also on the card's closed line, which opens the card by itself like «de confirmat»). Every person's row shows their choices as chips (a glyph and the role's name, never colour alone) and, while they are not cancelled, one press **«Dă-i rolul …»** per role they ticked and have not been given, plus «Alt rol» — a native select of every role of the event with how it stands («Sosire · 1 din 1») — and «Dă-i rolul ales». Each role's group lists the people given it, with «N din M». Giving a role is its own verb, asserted on the server for the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canManageVolunteers`), audited as `volunteer.assigned` (the volunteer's id, the role's and the one before, never the person's words), refused for a role of another event (`VALIDATION_ERROR`) and for a cancelled person (`CONFLICT`: reopen first); a press that changes nothing writes and sends nothing. «Adaugă un voluntar de mână» and every «Modifică» take the ticks («Ce e dispus(ă) să facă») and, optionally, «Rolul dat» (any role of the event, or none): at least one of the two; a person entered with a role given and nothing ticked has that role as their one choice, so every row says what the person offered. Taking a role back is «Modifică» → «Încă niciunul (de repartizat)».

**Emails.** The person's «Ți-am primit oferta…» names the roles they offered for on the bold line («Te-ai oferit pentru: Masă, Traseu»; the role given instead, once there is one, since the line is read at the send) and says the organizers choose the role and write when they have given it; the organizers' notice names the person and those roles. **A new message, `VOLUNTEER_ROLE_ASSIGNED`** («Rolul tău de voluntar la …» / “Your volunteer role at …”), one short message through the outbox, in the same transaction as the change, in the person's language with both halves: the role and the event's start and place on the bold line, what the role asks when the club wrote it, nothing to press and no token; queued whenever a role is newly given — by «Dă-i rolul», by «Modifică», or with a person entered by hand — and withdrawn at the send when the role was changed again or taken back since, the person was cancelled, or the address was corrected since (only the role that stands is announced, to the address the row holds). The house sends nothing on «Confirmat», so there was no confirmation to reuse. Its group is «confirmations», its privacy line the volunteers' list's.

**The volunteer agreement (§758).** `{{volunteerRole}}` and `{{volunteerTasks}}` read the role given when there is one — its name and what it asks —, else the roles chosen: «stabilit de organizatori; voluntarul este disponibil pentru: Masă, Traseu» / “assigned by the organisers; the volunteer is available for: Desk, Course”, fitted to the approved sentence «… în rolul {{volunteerRole}}.», so every version in force reads right and no template changes; the tasks are each chosen role's description by name («Masă — dă numerele; Traseu — arată drumul»; one role: its description alone; none: the sentence is left out). A sign-up on the form, which has no role given, accepts those words; the stored blanks, the fingerprint and the PDF follow (`agreementRoleWords`). The link's page says «disponibil(ă) pentru: …» while no role is given. «Semnat pe hârtie» posts back what the printed sheet named — the role given, or the roles chosen (`agreementRolesStamp`) — and is refused (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_REPRINT`) when either changed since. The card's «Contractul acceptat numește …» shows only when the accepted words no longer describe the person: given a role they never offered for, or their choices changed (`agreementStillNamesRole`).

**The CSV** gains «S-a oferit pentru» (the roles chosen, joined by «, », in the club's order) beside «Rolul dat» (empty while none); its rows are grouped by the role given, the offers to place first. «Toate datele unei persoane» lists every role an offer ticked beside the role given, so an access request stays complete.

**The privacy notice's template**, section 5, now says the offer keeps «rolurile pe care le-ai bifat și rolul pe care ți-l dau organizatorii» and that «când organizatorii îți dau un rol, primești un e-mail scurt care îl numește»; the marker and the switch are unchanged. Only a version the club approves has effect (§639's email tells the Administrators the template moved); a lawyer reads the paragraph with the rest.

**Not changed:** the agreement's gates and acceptance, the privacy rules (no public list of volunteers, no address in an email to the organizers or in the trail), the retention (the choices go with the offer), the event's JSON file (volunteers never travel), registrations and the capacity.

**Refused.** Counting an offer against a role's need (a role would fill with people who were only willing, and the organizers could not choose); giving the first role ticked by itself (the organizers asked to choose); an order of preference among the ticked roles (nobody asked; the message box carries it); a `RESTRICT` on the choice's role (it refused deleting an event, above); a second form for staff (the card's verbs are the house's plain forms).

Amends §754 and §758.
changelogLine: - **Volunteers tick every role they would do** — «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci» on the event's page takes several roles; the organizers find each offer under «De repartizat» on the «Voluntari» card, give one role with one press («Dă-i rolul …») and the person is told by a short email; «N din M» counts only the roles given; the CSV and the agreement name the roles chosen. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event that takes volunteers, when a visitor opens «Vreau să fiu voluntar», then «Ce ești dispus(ă) să faci» offers one checkbox per role that still needs people — its name, its description and how many it still needs, 44 pixels a row, working with scripts off — and a post with none ticked is refused naming the box; a post keeps the ticked roles that still need people as the person's choices and gives the row no role; a ticked role that filled meanwhile is dropped and the others kept; only when none is left is the answer «full», given before the repeat is looked for, to a listed address and a stranger alike (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event's «Voluntari» card, then «N din M» counts only the people given each role («Înscris» and «Confirmat»), the public form reads the same count, and the offers with no role given are listed under «De repartizat» above the roles, each with its choices as chips, one «Dă-i rolul …» per role ticked and «Alt rol» for any role of the event; giving a role is audited as `volunteer.assigned`, refused for another event's role and for a cancelled person; a person entered by hand or changed takes the roles ticked and, optionally, the role given — at least one of the two; a role anybody was given or ticked is not deleted; the CSV carries «Rolul dat» and «S-a oferit pentru» (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Migration `0149_volunteer_role_choices` is expand-only: the message type `VOLUNTEER_ROLE_ASSIGNED`, the table `event_volunteer_role_choices` (the volunteer and the role each `ON DELETE CASCADE`, the pair the primary key) and `event_volunteers.role_id` relaxed to accept NULL; each existing volunteer's role becomes their one choice and stays the role given; an event with offers still deletes whole (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a role newly given to a volunteer — by «Dă-i rolul …», by «Modifică» or with a person entered by hand — then one `VOLUNTEER_ROLE_ASSIGNED` is queued in the same transaction, to the person in their language, naming the role, the event's start and place and what the role asks, with no token; it is withdrawn at the send when the role was changed again or taken back, the person cancelled or the address corrected since; and the person's «am primit» and the organizers' notice name the roles the person offered for (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer agreement accepted or printed for a person, then `{{volunteerRole}}` and `{{volunteerTasks}}` name the role given and what it asks, else «stabilit de organizatori; voluntarul este disponibil pentru: …» with the roles chosen and what each asks; the stored blanks, the fingerprint and the PDF follow, and «Semnat pe hârtie» is refused (`VOLUNTEER_AGREEMENT_REPRINT`) when the role given or the roles chosen changed since the sheet was printed (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Dă-i rolul …», when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator asks — the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer, a member — then the server refuses (`FORBIDDEN`) and nothing is written or sent (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a person's offers to volunteer, when «Toate datele unei persoane» is read or exported, then each lists the role given (or none) and every role the person ticked; no public page, cache or event file names a volunteer or their choices (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
